A1.justification: Both complete 16-page PDFs describe the same VaLiK work and include matching text, equations, figures, tables, references and Appendices A–G. Page-by-page comparison supports reliable assessment throughout.

before.justification: v2 reports original VaLiK experiments on CrisisMMD and ScienceQA, including benchmark results, component ablations and a VLM-count analysis in Tables 1–5 and Figure 4.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original classification, question-answering, ablation and VLM-count results in Tables 1–5 and Figure 4.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical cascaded VLM description generation, similarity pruning, LightRAG graph construction and retrieval procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same CrisisMMD classification tasks and ScienceQA question-answering coverage. No training or evaluation dataset, domain or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in Tables 1–3, including LightRAG, Mmkg, Visual Genome and the same LLM/VLM baselines. Appendix G retains the same comparison with the original CoE aggregation strategy.

E3.justification: The evaluation settings, model configurations, accuracy metrics, training-set knowledge construction and retrieval procedures are identical. Both retain validation-based threshold selection, with thresholds of 0.25 for CrisisMMD and 0.20 for ScienceQA.

E4.justification: The component ablations in Tables 4–5, VLM-count analysis in Figure 4, and supplementary case studies, sensitivity discussion and design comparisons remain unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report the same point accuracies without experimental run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes in the appendices.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings match, including appendix outcomes. For example, Table 3 reports identical ScienceQA averages of 83.16% and 84.77% for VaLiK Text-Image with Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2.5-72B, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(12), the graph and similarity definitions, and their mathematical explanations are identical. No assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about annotation-free, zero-shot MMKG construction, storage efficiency, modularity and enhanced multimodal reasoning.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of model-size effects, textual–visual knowledge imbalance, over-pruning on ScienceQA and ensemble/computational tradeoffs in Sections 4.2–4.4 and Appendix G.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendices D–G provide identical implementation, hardware, threshold-selection, retrieval and construction-time details. The code link and availability statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, contribution positioning and 91-entry bibliography are identical. No cited work or substantive relationship to prior research changes.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv banner changes from v2, dated 24 Jul 2025, to v3, dated 21 Nov 2025. The title, authors, prose, headings and main-text/appendix organization are otherwise identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–7, Tables 1–6 and Algorithm 1 retain identical displays, captions and positions. Rendered pages match except for the version/date lettering in the first-page margin; the layout is unchanged.

improvement.justification: The only visible revision is administrative version/date information. The methods, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility disclosures and Appendices A–G are identical, establishing no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
